scope: Project-wide speed and correctness audit; entries distinguish initial scans from verified changes.

areas.notes: Source reads and pure package accounting remain on main thread. Cache resolves the actual writable game path through renderer API 11.

findings: Bounded PNG/TGA reads and RGBA8 output; 16-bit PNG conversion and TGA orientations/packets tested
JPEG failure recovery and bounded encoder output
Captured texture context preserves queued processing after live setting changes
Pure decoder callbacks use private malloc buffers on worker threads
Automatic residency scales with device memory and exact driver extension query
Budget reductions reclaim fragmented idle pages
Deferred registration decoding and immutable per-job settings
Prepared cache implemented but defaults off: world-only timing showed no complete-cycle benefit
Result checking no longer shadows an outer VkResult named result

areas.notes: Shared image safety fixes, HDR decode failure/null output handling, 32-light/shadow bit masks, skin parsers, split paths, and shader type declaration reviewed. Full renderer builds verify integration.

findings: Bounded memory/streamed WAV parsing and safe music read arithmetic
SFX long-phase wrap, low-rate replay, output overflow and negative-shift UB fixed
Common-rate PCM and volume match old output

areas.notes: Safe wildcard matching, recording/snapshot cvar handling, console padding and entity-interface bounds; packet-parser candidates retained for review.
Missing preview handles, map bounds/empty catalog, malformed cvarInt parameters and arena allocation failure covered by baseline-failing fixtures.
Snapshot display guards and renderer light masks fixed; populated-scene effects/animation performance still needs representative profiling.

Navigation bounds/cleanup and bulk rank/edge reads; all 25 installed nav files round-trip unchanged. Pause recipients, BSP origin and shader parse failures fixed. Icarus helper failure propagation being tested.

MSVC flags preserve language settings and do not accumulate across reconfigure. Every standalone suite now discovered by local runner and three-platform CI. Last checkpoint: 24/24 suites passed before final added fixtures.

residency.method: Three rotated-order rounds at each budget; fresh profiles, warm OS cache, identical local T1_Fatal/mp/ffa3/T1_Fatal cycle; no concurrent build or other game client.
residency.limit: Repeated loads improved; the first map was effectively unchanged. This is not a matched SJK comparison.

worker_decode_world_scope.method: Same prototype binary, three alternating pairs, 2048 MiB GPU residency, disk cache off; fresh profiles, warm OS cache, no compilation/static analysis/other game client.
worker_decode_world_scope.limit: First two loads improved; revisit did not. This measures world-scope prototype, not final broader registration.

prepared_cache_world_scope.method: Three rotated-order rounds off/cold/warm, same binary/settings, 2048 MiB GPU residency, automatic workers. Pipeline cache seeded identically; warm textures copied before timer. No concurrent build/analysis/game.
prepared_cache_world_scope.decision: No overall speed gain in this prototype; default disabled. Final broader registration requires separate measurements.

navigation.limit: Filesystem call count and byte-identical roundtrip checks, not a wall-clock claim.

registration_decode.method: Same binary, three alternating pairs, GPU cache2048MiB, diskoff, fresh profiles,warmOS cache, no concurrentlocalCPU work.

checkpoint_features.method: Three rotated-order rounds; one feature disabled at a time in same binary; cache2048MiB, decoderworkersauto,diskoff,freshprofiles,warmOS cache,quietmachine.

verification_state: Checkpoint validated: Windows x86/x64,30 standalone suites, real normal/custom player menus and Vulkan core/sync validation. Broader runtime/audit work remains.

analysis.qualification: Diagnostics require individual source review/fixtures. Initial scan preceded later changes; modified units receive targeted follow-up analysis.
analysis.compatibility: Two bot contexts needed the recorded Clang MSVC-header narrowing switch; Rend2 shader type declaration was fixed.
